Screens

Click here to see how to use the tool
  • Open a story. Use Upload ZIP, Upload HTML, or Upload Folder, or drag a file onto the box. Images and logos are saved into the export.
  • Move between screens using the Screens list on the left. The Slides / Flow button changes how it plays. Slides lists every screen. Flow plays it as one click-through, where a single click moves it forward.
  • Turn on Edit to make changes, and click Edit again to turn it off.
  • Change text. In Edit mode, double-click any text and type over it. This works on the slide and inside the phone panels like the concierge. Changes save on their own.
  • Move and resize. Click an item to select it, drag it to move, and drag the red dot to resize. Logos stay sharp at any size.
  • Size and colour. The Size box sets text size. The Text picker sets text colour. Icon/Logo recolours a selected logo.
  • Add a logo. Type a brand address like nike.com to fetch its logo, upload your own file, or pick one you used before. Your logos are saved for next time.
  • Copy and paste with Ctrl or Cmd plus C and V. Delete or Backspace removes the selected item. Undo reverts the last change.
  • Export. Export Playable HTML saves one file that runs on its own. Export ZIP keeps the images as separate files.
